verdict.rationale: Terraform ships a native `terraform test` framework for validating module changes. Tests run against test-specific, short-lived resources, "preventing any risk to your existing infrastructure or state." Since v1.7, provider mocking lets tests run without real resources at all, and test runs can emit machine-readable JSON for automation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the test framework (no community evidence discusses `terraform test`).
